Topics covered in this PDF

BERE-141 (Institutional Support to MSMEs) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • MSME Development Act 2006, SFCs and SIDCs, tool rooms and technology centres
  • Commercial banks, credit guarantee schemes, NSSH for SC and ST enterprises
  • NIESBUD, IIE, equity shareholders and preference shareholders, large-cap and mid-cap equity funds

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: answer any five questions, each carries 20 marks, maximum marks 100
  • Seven questions are printed (Q1 to Q7), with parts in Q4, Q6 and Q7; this PDF solves all of them

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:
